display.purpose: The single task or workspace heading.

title.purpose: Terminal states and truthful empty states.

body.purpose: Instructions and explanation inside the readable measure.

shadows.name: overlay-ambient
shadows.purpose: Contextual help overlay only; forms and primary surfaces remain flat.

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Short color, border, and focus transitions on controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The full-width, high-confidence action for the current task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--text-strong, #09090b); color: var(--surface-page, #ffffff); font: 550 1rem/1.5 sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A safe alternate action that remains visually subordinate.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-page, #ffffff); color: var(--text-strong, #09090b); font: 550 1rem/1.5 sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #a1a1aa); background: var(--surface-subtle, #fafafa); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled, described control with crisp neutral and repair states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--text-strong, #09090b); font: 600 14px/1.5 sans-serif; } .ds-field small { color: var(--text-muted, #71717a); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-page, #ffffff); color: var(--text-strong, #09090b); font: 400 16px/1.5 sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #a1a1aa); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--focus, #2563eb); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 14%); }

components.name: Locale Navigation
components.description: A text-led header action that preserves the logical route.
components.css: .ds-locale a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding-inline: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text-body, #3f3f46); font: 400 14px/1.5 sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-locale a:hover { background: var(--surface-pressed, #f4f4f5); } .ds-locale a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Progress Rail
components.description: A restrained account, verification, and profile location cue.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--text-muted, #71717a); font: 400 12px/1.5 sans-serif; list-style: none; } .ds-progress li { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default, #e4e4e7); } .ds-progress .is-current { border-color: var(--trust, #047857); color: var(--text-strong, #09090b); }

components.name: Verified Status
components.description: A compact, non-decorative signal for confirmed account trust.
components.css: .ds-verified { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--trust, #047857); font: 600 13px/1.5 sans-serif; } .ds-verified i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--trust, #047857); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--trust-soft, #ecfdf5); }

narrative.overview:
Tender uses a deliberately narrow task frame to make commercial identity feel calm, exact, and trustworthy. Vercel is the craft benchmark for restraint and finish, not a template: Tender's verification states, capability truth, and Georgian-first typography make the world its own.

The system is typographically led and nearly monochrome. Negative space carries hierarchy; crisp borders describe controls; emerald appears only when trust is established; red appears only when repair is required. Interfaces state what is true and never fill an unfinished marketplace with decorative or fabricated content.
keyCharacteristics: One stable, top-anchored task frame across pending, error, and success states.
Georgian and English receive equal hierarchy, target size, and copy density.
Flat white surfaces, near-black actions, crisp neutral rules, and rare semantic color.
Direct-on-page forms instead of floating cards or marketing side panels.

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald means verified or safely active; red means repair; blue means focus. Never use those colors as decoration.

rules.name: The Paper-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: White and near-black must still describe the page when every semantic color is removed.

rules.name: The Equal-Script Rule
rules.body: Georgian may wrap earlier, but it is never reduced to a smaller role or lighter emphasis than English.

rules.name: The Tight-Heading Rule
rules.body: Display headings use compact tracking; body copy never inherits display compression.

rules.name: The Stable Anchor Rule
rules.body: State changes replace content inside the same frame. Pending, invalid, expired, reused, success, and access-denied states do not recenter or jump vertically.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A border or tonal shift must solve separation before elevation is considered.

dos: Do keep primary identity tasks inside the stable 460px measure.
Do use sentence-case labels and plain, specific repair copy.
Do preserve the action label during pending states and protect against duplicate submission.
Do reserve emerald for verified trust, red for repair, and blue for focus.
Do test Georgian and English at desktop and mobile widths.
donts: Don't wrap primary forms in floating cards or add a split-screen marketing panel.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, decorative shadows, or fabricated illustrations.
Don't introduce fake tenders, bids, ratings, revenue, or statistics to fill empty workspaces.
Don't expose capability, restriction, verification, or actor identity as editable controls.
Don't use semantic color as decoration or communicate status by color alone.
